run_training_xfields: run the xfields training pipeline with argparse flags for dataset path, type, dimension, and learning rate
train_light_view_time_interpolation: train a neural light field model for light-view-time interpolation using the Flow network and soft blending
train_single_type_interpolation: train a neural light field model for view, time, or light-only interpolation with L1 loss and Adam optimizer
save_trained_model_checkpoint: save the trained model checkpoint to disk during training when averaged L1 loss improves
visualize_flow_and_reconstruction: visualize optical flow fields and reconstructed images as PNG outputs and MP4 videos during training
